notes.title: Songs of Life OST is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are excited to announce that the Songs of Life soundtrack is now available!
The dedicated soundtrack contains 10 original songs by artists from Castalia Audio Inc. Each track was produced to emotionally inspire you through your gameplay. We hope these melodies can bring you back to the moments when you made important decisions and offer those who haven’t experienced the game a chance to feel it.

The 10 songs included:
[olist]
[*] - Songs of Life 
[*] - Echoes of a Vanishing Dream 
[*] - First Dawn Light
[*] - Floating Elegance 
[*] - Whispers of Power
[*] - Embered Feathers of Battle 
[*] - Labyrinth of Bronze Whispers 
[*] - Shadow Without Rhythm 
[*] - Lone Shadow's Lament 
[*] - Melody of Victory
[/olist]
Thanks for your support!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43919121/2c89a125d1ffe623f7e9b8c19946c9617b0c17b8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Three Kingdoms x Card-Based Visual Novel! Songs of Life is OUT TODAY!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Songs of Life is released with a 15% discount for the first two weeks.

This game is set in an alternate Three Kingdoms period of turmoil, telling the legendary story of three world-renowned doctors who write a story of benevolent healers in the plague-ridden, warlord-dominated Central Plains. Exquisite character cards, dynamic card interactions, and step-by-step advancement of the entire story's plot. Players will switch between different character perspectives during the game, follow the plot to heal patients with various difficult and complicated diseases. Players need to constantly make choices, unlock various notes, and unravel the truth behind the story.

Faced with the chaotic world and plague of the late Eastern Han Dynasty, can you become a member of saving the world? In order to find the root cause of the plague, embark on a journey to save the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43919121/580623f9795550a7a20c4e58329acbfc75a7b4b9.png[/img]

notes.title: 1 days until the release of "Song of Life"
notes.notes:
1 days until the release of "Song of Life"!

The historical fiction visual novel "Song of Life" set in the Three Kingdoms period is officially set to release on March 4th.

The game is set in the late Han Dynasty. Years of war and disasters have brought misery to the people, and plagues are rampant. Players will play as three divine doctors traveling across China, seeking to save the people. Now, let us go to the troubled times of the late Han Dynasty, transform into divine doctors who relieve suffering and save the world, fight against the raging plague, and find the truth that led to the chaos of this era!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43919121/9ca590cd8facdaa77f88755e76f6f00df6fd3d31.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 2-day countdown! Song of Life is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you for your enthusiastic experience and feedback on the "Song of Life" demo. Thanks to your enthusiastic feedback, we have received many valuable suggestions. Now the game will be officially released on March 4th. 

Due to the large changes in the content of the official version, and in order to fully welcome the arrival of the official version, we have now removed the game's demo. We believe that the official version of Song of Life will be able to present you with more excellent game content.

Thank you again for your long-term support and expectations. Players who have not yet followed us can click "Follow" and add to their wishlists on the store page. We eagerly look forward to seeing you in the upcoming official version!

DreamStep
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43919121/ad243721d7e3b85cec5a8c32837b32bb251455f0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Song of life Confirmed to Join Chinese New Year Steam Event
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We're happy to announce that we're joining the Chinese New Year celebration event. Sorry to keep you all waiting for the full version of the game and for the radio silence regarding the development. Believe us, we're working hard on getting everything ready for The Grand Release, stay tuned!

We hope you are as excited as we are for the official release and we wish you a wonderful Year of the Snake!

notes.title: New PV is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we bring you a brand new video, which will showcase the story background and gameplay content. We hope the game can provide you with more immersive gaming experience.

Songs of Life takes place at the end of the Han Dynasty, where a mysterious disease sweeps across the land, leading to famine and war, leaving countless dead and bloodshed. In the game, you will play as the three divine doctors: Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Dong Feng, using surgery, medicine, and even divine powers to personally end this tragic era of chaos and uncover the huge conspiracy hidden behind the epidemic.

The launch date for our official version of the game is getting closer. Stay tuned and feel free to add our game to your wishlist if you are interested. We eagerly look forward to the day when the game officially meets all of you!

https://youtu.be/7C8APg5JDB4

notes.title: Meet Songs of Life on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We are excited to announce that Songs of Life will participate Steam Next Fest! 
During the Fest, there is a free demo available for everyone to give the game a try during the event and we’d love to read your feedback on it through our Discord! 

We also have a pre-recorded broadcast where you can see the game being played by our team, which will be looped throughout the duration of Next Fest. 

Don’t forget to WISHLIST Songs of Life if you like the Demo. 
Thank you for all of your support so far !
